title: viz1090
summary: Full-screen ADS-B display: live aircraft from an RTL-SDR dongle on a world map.
description: The real viz1090 (by Nathan Matsuda) on the deck, full screen, with its own decoder (readsb with RTL-SDR support), an intro screen (whether the SDR and a USB GPS are found; your position from the nearest airport code, the GPS, latitude and longitude, or a recent place; by touch or keyboard) and a world map. Rows show what can be tapped: a chevron opens or changes, a dot runs. Needs an RTL-SDR dongle with a 1090 MHz antenna, a screen of at least 640x480 and a launcher with full-screen support (X-Fullscreen in .desktop files). Map data: Natural Earth and OurAirports. viz1090: BSD licence; readsb: GPL-3 (source: https://github.com/wiedehopf/readsb); the intro screen and the display bridge: MIT.
depends: libsdl2-2.0-0, libsdl2-ttf-2.0-0, libsdl2-gfx-1.0-0, librtlsdr0, libusb-1.0-0, libfreetype6, libinput10, libxkbcommon0, libncurses6, libzstd1, zlib1g, python3
